head: 24408161c7572d834d355c637efd28adc09700e3
claim: A slow Claude Code sign-in check no longer signs the person out: it is retried past 10 s and reads unknown, a recovering one reads signed in, and a signed-out one still reads signed out

steps.start: A built @byokit/openclaw checkout (npm run build exited 0; the import resolves inside packages/openclaw/dist) with a fresh state dir per probe and a loopback fake gateway whose engine probe answers Claude Code sign-in status; no account, key or network.
steps: Built the SDK with npm run build and checked that the built @byokit/openclaw entry resolves
Ran the public-entry drive openclaw-slow-probe-unknown.mjs, which starts a kit with a new state dir for each case
Case 1: the Claude Code probe takes 3.5 s and errors on every attempt; asked the kit for the sign-in state of a member on claude-cli, then started a Claude Code run for that member
Case 2: the Claude Code probe errors twice and then answers credentials present; asked the sign-in state, then started a run
Case 3: the Claude Code probe answers credentials absent; asked the sign-in state, then started a run
Read the printed results and the drive's DRIVE OK line and exit code
steps.result: The always-failing slow probe reads unknown after 12.6 s of retries (6 probes) with no provider status, and its run ends network. The probe that recovers reads signed-in after 9 s (3 probes), providerStatus lists claude-cli, and the run is ok. The signed-out probe reads signed-out with no provider status, and its run ends signed-out. The drive exits 0 with DRIVE OK.

verdicts.seen: Read all 3 entries. 'slow probe' has state "unknown" with probes 6 and seconds 12.6, matching the retried-past-10s case. 'slow twice, then signed in' has state "signed-in" with run "ok", probes 3, seconds 9, and providerStatus ["claude-cli"]. 'signed out' has state "signed-out" with run "signed-out" and probes 0. All three outcome parts are shown, and nothing contradicts them.

Read all 3 entries in the same results set. 'slow probe' has state "unknown" with seconds 12.6. 'slow twice, then signed in' has state "signed-in" with run "ok". 'signed out' has state "signed-out" with run "signed-out". The JSON matches capture_0 and shows all three outcome parts.
